_note: Small reviewed bilingual evidence collection for the fictional Northtown reservoir scenario. All documents are scenario records written by the authors; none is a real-world source. relations = reviewed evidence-claim links (fact_id -> S supports / R refutes). F3 (city-wide cuts) and F6 (Harbour district cut) are separate facts with different scope; E3 and E6 give a genuine conflict on F3 (same date, same scope, different publishers). The scenario truth is fixed in the fact base (F3 is false): E6 is a reviewed record of a wrong newspaper report.

F1.en: The reservoir level fell 12% this month.
F1.tr: Baraj doluluğu bu ay yüzde 12 düştü.

F3.en: City-wide water cuts start next week.
F3.tr: Gelecek hafta şehir genelinde su kesintisi başlıyor.

F4.en: The drop is caused by the new hotel district.

F5.en: Officials are hiding the real numbers.

F6.en: A water cut is scheduled in the Harbour district next week.
F6.tr: Gelecek hafta Liman bölgesinde su kesintisi planlandı.

evidence.title: Monthly reservoir report, October
evidence.text: The reservoir level fell 12% this month and the reservoir is now at 58% of capacity. The main cause of the drop is low rainfall; demand from new districts, including the hotel district, is not a significant factor.

evidence.title: Aylık baraj raporu, Ekim
evidence.text: Baraj doluluğu bu ay yüzde 12 düştü ve baraj şu anda kapasitesinin yüzde 58'inde. Düşüşün ana nedeni az yağış; otel bölgesi dahil yeni bölgelerin talebi önemli bir etken değil.

evidence.title: Press statement on water supply
evidence.text: No city-wide water cuts are planned for next week. The real reservoir numbers are published every week on the authority website.

evidence.title: Su arzı hakkında basın açıklaması
evidence.text: Gelecek hafta şehir genelinde su kesintisi planlanmıyor. Gerçek baraj rakamları her hafta idarenin internet sitesinde yayımlanıyor.

evidence.title: Maintenance notice
evidence.text: A scheduled water cut will take place in the Harbour district next Tuesday for pipe maintenance.

evidence.title: News report on water supply
evidence.text: City officials told the newspaper that city-wide water cuts will start next week because rainfall stayed low.
